sources.role: Primary legal boundary description and map custody/sheet inventory
sources.license: Open Government Licence v3.0 for legislation.gov.uk legislation text; attribution required; any third-party content remains subject to its terms.
sources.coverage_and_precision: Text describes the river boundary by medium filum and island channels and the Lake Kariba reach by straight lines. It names deposited signed 1:50,000 and smaller-scale sheets but is not a georeferenced map image and gives no candidate-scale positional accuracy.
sources.limits: Does not show the deposited map images, locate the ten components, establish present bilateral interpretation, or determine physical water status.

sources.role: Contemporaneous U.S. Department of State boundary study; secondary reproduction of legal text and approximate named-island coordinates
sources.retention: restoration-only; PDF not copied because host scan/format reuse terms were not established
sources.restoration: Retrieve from the cited Florida State University Law Library URL; verify any host-specific scan terms before redistribution.
sources.license: Unknown for the university-hosted scan/format. U.S. federal employee-authored report text is public domain under U.S. copyright, but this does not establish rights in all scan components.
sources.coverage_and_precision: Regional boundary narrative, deposited map-sheet list, and approximate whole-minute coordinates for named islands.
sources.limits: Approximate coordinates are not a survey control or accuracy statement; report does not identify any of the ten components or four contacts and cannot establish current water or boundary status.

sources.role: Library catalogue record for Zimbabwe Surveyor-General 1:50,000 topographic maps and sheet titles
sources.retention: restoration-only; no catalogue HTML or map image redistributed
sources.license: Unknown for catalogue-page redistribution; only factual bibliographic identifiers and titles are reported here.
sources.coverage_and_precision: Bibliographic index lists 564 sheets, including 1529 C3 Nyakasanga, 1529 C4 Rukomechi, 1530 C1 Mupata Gorge, 1530 C2 Kanyemba, and 1628 B2 Chirundu, at 1:50,000.
sources.limits: Catalogue does not establish map-image availability, georeferencing, positional accuracy, or identity with the signed 1963 deposited boundary maps.

sources.role: Official description of ZAMWIS data classes and intended basin-wide information system
sources.license: Unknown for redistribution of page content.
sources.coverage_and_precision: Describes the system as holding contemporary and historical spatial data, hydrological time series, and Earth-observation information for the Zambezi Basin.
sources.limits: Public description did not expose an item-level downloadable candidate dataset or metadata; no physical-water inference is made.

sources.license: Unknown for service-layer data; no layer data retained or redistributed.

responsible_custodians: Current Surveyor-General offices of Zambia and Zimbabwe: obtain signed 1963 deposited map sheets and map-registration/accuracy/reuse metadata.
ZAMCOM/ZAMWIS or ZRA: identify date-stamped, candidate-scale hydrology or Earth-observation sources and their metadata/licensing.
handoff.resume_condition: A custodian supplies retained source bytes or a stable public item/API with adequate coverage, date, scale/resolution, positional metadata, and lawful reuse terms.
handoff.status: No external request was sent; all ten water classifications and component classes remain unchanged.
